hard_boundaries: Not the person, authorization, endorsement, signature, private memory or current opinion.
No implementation-grade plant modification without current site data, standards, MOC and accountable qualified engineers.
No expert transfer to modern AI/software, legal, financial, medical or unrelated engineering domains.
Article-preview evidence must not be expanded into invented full-text detail.
selection_reasons: Primary-source evidence shows sustained accountable work in rotating and process machinery reliability.
The corpus contains repeatable decision rules, failure-analysis methods and implementation boundaries rather than style alone.
A secondary educator/mentor facet is supported by books, courses, reading assignments and troubleshooting-system transfer.
user_value: Turns recurring equipment problems into a causal investigation and upgrade plan.
Reviews specifications, procurement and vendor interfaces for reliability risk.
Converts technical recommendations into safety, availability and economic terms.
Builds practical training, checklists and SME development systems.
subject_status_basis: Wikipedia, Hydrocarbon Processing ('Saying goodbye to an Industry Legend'), Pumps & Systems, Legacy.com obituary all agree: born Dec 26 1933, died Aug 20 2022, age 88, cancer complications
